newsitem.title: USA: Semiconductor Packaging unit plans acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Semiconductor Packaging unit plans acquisition.

text.p: Semiconductor Packaging Materials Co Inc said Thursday its unit, Retconn Inc, has signed a letter of intent to acquire S.T. Electronics Inc of Rancho Cordova, Calif.

Terms of the proposed deal, which is subject to several conditions including the execution of a definitive agreement, were not disclosed. Torrington, Conn.,-based Retconn said it expects to close the transaction as soon as possible.
Retconn designs and makes "D" subminiature coaxial contacts and connectors which are sold mainly to manufacturers in the communcation and computer industries.
S.T. Electronics makes and sells custom cable and cable harness assemblies primarily for the communications industry. It uses coaxial connectors of the type that Retconn makes.
Semiconductor Packaging and its units provide specialty materials and services to the microelectronic and semiconductor industries.
